correctness.rationale: Exact kernel/image coordinates plus the two mutually inverse restrictions give the crossed-transversal bijection. Compositions with positive parts yield E(n,r)=binomial(n+r-1,2r-1), and two independent incidence choices give its square. The factorial ratio gives the exact mode inequality, the complete positive Pell solutions give the tie family, and uniform Stirling plus discrete Laplace estimates yield the all-n asymptotic constant and Gaussian local limit. Standard-library scripts independently test full ordered-pair multiplication through n=6 and all incidences through n=11, plus Pell tie and asymptotic values; finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The new finite and limiting invariants quantify the entire mutual-inverse relation for the natural chain-isotone monoid at the heart of a recent matching-existence result. They determine exact densities for every rank, prove a sharp exceptional Pell family of discrete maximizers, show golden-ratio growth, and give a central-limit law and exponentially small random-pair probability. This goes beyond the classical idempotent triangle and existence of a matching; the natural structural invariant is motivated by inverse-edge density, not an arbitrary finite slice.
